title: Binance Futures to Relaunch USDⓈ-M BNX Perpetual Contracts with Up to 20X Leverage
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will relaunch USDⓈ-M BNX Perpetual Contracts at  2023-02-22 14:45 (UTC)  with up to 20x leverage. More details on BNXUSDT Perpetual Contracts can be found in the table below: USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts BNXUSDT Launch Time  2023-02-22 14:45 (UTC)  Underlying Asset BNX Settlement Asset USDT Tick Size 0.001 Capped Funding Rate Clamp (Funding Rate, -0.75 * Maintenance Margin Ratio, 0.75 * Maintenance Margin Ratio) Max Leverage 20x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Asset Mode Supported Please note:  The old BNXUSDT Perpetual Contract, which underwent  settlement at 2023-02-11 04:00 (UTC) , will be renamed as “BNXUSDTSETTLED”. In addition, to provide users with a better trading experience, Binance has removed the old candlestick charts for USDⓈ-M BNX Perpetual Contracts from the trading page, effective from  2023-02-22 06:30 (UTC) . With this update, users are no longer able to use  GET /fapi/v1/continuousKlines  to access the old candlestick data for USDⓈ-M BNX Perpetual Contracts. Please note that users can continue using  GET /fapi/v1/klines  to access all the candlestick charts data for BNXUSDTSETTLED Perpetual Contracts. Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the contracts from time to time, which include the tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Asset Mode  allows users to trade BNXUSDT Perpetual Contracts across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Asset Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading BNXUSDT Perpetual Contracts.  BNXUSDT Perpetual Contracts are subject to the terms of the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement . Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail.
